# 1. Data Loading and Preparation

```{r load-data}
# Load person-level datasets
main_2024 <- read_csv("../data/main-2024-person-level.csv") %>% mutate(year = "2024")
main_2020 <- read_csv("../data/main-2020-person-level.csv") %>% mutate(year = "2020")
main_2016 <- read_csv("../data/main-2016-person-level.csv") %>% mutate(year = "2016")

# Hard-coded 2016 referral values from paper
referrers_2016 <- tibble(
  url_type = c("untrustworthy", "hard_news", "other"),
  facebook_refs_per = c(0.151, 0.059, 0.075),  # Facebook referrals
  twitter_refs_per = c(0.010, 0.015, 0.008),   # Twitter referrals
  google_refs_per = c(0.033, 0.062, 0.0475)    # Google referrals
)

# QA check of loaded data
print("Data Loading QA Check:")
print(paste("2024 Person-level records:", nrow(main_2024)))
print(paste("2020 Person-level records:", nrow(main_2020)))
print(paste("2016 Person-level records:", nrow(main_2016)))
```

# 2. Sample Description

## 2.1 Sample Demographics

```{r demographics}
# Calculate unweighted demographic counts and percentages
demographics <- main_2024 %>%
  summarise(
    # Total sample size
    n_total = n(),
    
    # Political support
    n_harris = sum(harris_supporter == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_trump = sum(trump_supporter == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    per_harris = mean(harris_supporter == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    per_trump = mean(trump_supporter == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Age groups
    n_65plus = sum(age_65_plus == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_45_64 = sum(age_45_64 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_30_44 = sum(age_30_44 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_under30 = sum(age_18_29 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    per_65plus = mean(age_65_plus == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    per_45_64 = mean(age_45_64 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    per_30_44 = mean(age_30_44 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    per_under30 = mean(age_18_29 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Gender
    n_male = sum(female == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_female = sum(female == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    per_male = mean(female == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    per_female = mean(female == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Political interest and knowledge
    # Note: political_interest is 1-4 scale, higher = more interest
    n_high_interest = sum(political_interest >= 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    per_high_interest = mean(political_interest >= 3, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

To measure exposure to Untrustworthy Website during the 2024 election, we fielded a two-wave online survey via YouGov to `r demographics$n_total` participants. We also passively gathered web browsing data from those participants using YouGov's Pulse browser plugin from October 8, 2024 to November 12, 2024 (Election Day was November 5, 2024). All participants consented to the terms of the research and were compensated by YouGov for their participation.

Of these participants, `r scales::percent(demographics$per_harris, accuracy = 0.1)` (n = `r demographics$n_harris`) self-reported as supporting Kamala Harris in the 2024 election while `r scales::percent(demographics$per_trump, accuracy = 0.1)` (n = `r demographics$n_trump`) self-reported as supporting Donald Trump. `r scales::percent(demographics$per_65plus, accuracy = 0.1)` (n = `r demographics$n_65plus`) were aged 65+, `r scales::percent(demographics$per_45_64, accuracy = 0.1)` (n = `r demographics$n_45_64`) were 45-64, `r scales::percent(demographics$per_30_44, accuracy = 0.1)` (n = `r demographics$n_30_44`) were 30-44, and `r scales::percent(demographics$per_under30, accuracy = 0.1)` (n = `r demographics$n_under30`) were under 30.

`r scales::percent(demographics$per_male, accuracy = 0.1)` (n = `r demographics$n_male`) reported identifying as male and `r scales::percent(demographics$per_female, accuracy = 0.1)` (n = `r demographics$n_female`) reported identifying as female. `r scales::percent(demographics$per_high_interest, accuracy = 0.1)` (n = `r demographics$n_high_interest`) said they follow politics most or some of the time.

YouGov weighted participants to match a nationally-representative sample and we use these weights in all subsequent calculations and results.

# 3. RQ1: Comparison of 2024 vs 2020 Untrustworthy Website Exposure

## 3.1 Overall Exposure (H1)

```{r}
# Calculate 2024 exposure rate with weighted mean and standard error
exposure_2024 <- tibble(
  mean = diagis::weighted_mean(
    x = main_2024$untrustworthy_flag,
    w = main_2024$weight),
  se = diagis::weighted_se(
    x = main_2024$untrustworthy_flag,
    w = main_2024$weight)
) %>%
mutate(
  low = mean - se * 1.96,
  high = mean + se * 1.96,
  year = "2024"
)

# Calculate 2020 exposure rate
exposure_2020 <- tibble(
  mean = diagis::weighted_mean(
    x = main_2020$untrustworthy_flag,
    w = main_2020$weight),
  se = diagis::weighted_se(
    x = main_2020$untrustworthy_flag,
    w = main_2020$weight)
) %>%
mutate(
  low = mean - se * 1.96,
  high = mean + se * 1.96,
  year = "2020"
)

# Calculate 2016 exposure rate
exposure_2016 <- tibble(
  mean = diagis::weighted_mean(
    x = main_2016$untrustworthy_flag,
    w = main_2016$weight),
  se = diagis::weighted_se(
    x = main_2016$untrustworthy_flag,
    w = main_2016$weight)
) %>%
mutate(
  low = mean - se * 1.96,
  high = mean + se * 1.96,
  year = "2016"
)
```


```{r exposure_calculations}
# Sample sizes (both total and effective)
n_2024 <- nrow(main_2024)
n_2020 <- nrow(main_2020)
n_2016 <- nrow(main_2016)
n_effective_2024 <- sum(!is.na(main_2024$untrustworthy_flag) & !is.na(main_2024$weight))
n_effective_2020 <- sum(!is.na(main_2020$untrustworthy_flag) & !is.na(main_2020$weight))
n_effective_2016 <- sum(!is.na(main_2016$untrustworthy_flag) & !is.na(main_2016$weight))

# Calculate additional comparison metrics for 2024 vs 2020
# Absolute percentage point difference
abs_diff_2024_2020 <- exposure_2024$mean - exposure_2020$mean
abs_diff_se_2024_2020 <- sqrt(exposure_2024$se^2 + exposure_2020$se^2)
abs_diff_ci_low_2024_2020 <- abs_diff_2024_2020 - 1.96 * abs_diff_se_2024_2020
abs_diff_ci_high_2024_2020 <- abs_diff_2024_2020 + 1.96 * abs_diff_se_2024_2020

# Calculate additional comparison metrics for 2020 vs 2016
abs_diff_2020_2016 <- exposure_2020$mean - exposure_2016$mean
abs_diff_se_2020_2016 <- sqrt(exposure_2020$se^2 + exposure_2016$se^2)
abs_diff_ci_low_2020_2016 <- abs_diff_2020_2016 - 1.96 * abs_diff_se_2020_2016
abs_diff_ci_high_2020_2016 <- abs_diff_2020_2016 + 1.96 * abs_diff_se_2020_2016

# Relative risk (RR) for 2024 vs 2020
relative_risk_2024_2020 <- exposure_2024$mean / exposure_2020$mean
log_rr_se_2024_2020 <- sqrt((exposure_2024$se^2 / exposure_2024$mean^2) + 
                           (exposure_2020$se^2 / exposure_2020$mean^2))
rr_ci_low_2024_2020 <- exp(log(relative_risk_2024_2020) - 1.96 * log_rr_se_2024_2020)
rr_ci_high_2024_2020 <- exp(log(relative_risk_2024_2020) + 1.96 * log_rr_se_2024_2020)

# Relative risk (RR) for 2020 vs 2016
relative_risk_2020_2016 <- exposure_2020$mean / exposure_2016$mean
log_rr_se_2020_2016 <- sqrt((exposure_2020$se^2 / exposure_2020$mean^2) + 
                           (exposure_2016$se^2 / exposure_2016$mean^2))
rr_ci_low_2020_2016 <- exp(log(relative_risk_2020_2016) - 1.96 * log_rr_se_2020_2016)
rr_ci_high_2020_2016 <- exp(log(relative_risk_2020_2016) + 1.96 * log_rr_se_2020_2016)

# Odds ratios (OR) for 2024 vs 2020
odds_2024 <- exposure_2024$mean / (1 - exposure_2024$mean)
odds_2020 <- exposure_2020$mean / (1 - exposure_2020$mean)
odds_ratio_2024_2020 <- odds_2024 / odds_2020
log_or_se_2024_2020 <- sqrt((exposure_2024$se^2 / (exposure_2024$mean^2 * (1-exposure_2024$mean)^2)) + 
                           (exposure_2020$se^2 / (exposure_2020$mean^2 * (1-exposure_2020$mean)^2)))
or_ci_low_2024_2020 <- exp(log(odds_ratio_2024_2020) - 1.96 * log_or_se_2024_2020)
or_ci_high_2024_2020 <- exp(log(odds_ratio_2024_2020) + 1.96 * log_or_se_2024_2020)

# Odds ratios (OR) for 2020 vs 2016
odds_2016 <- exposure_2016$mean / (1 - exposure_2016$mean)
odds_ratio_2020_2016 <- odds_2020 / odds_2016
log_or_se_2020_2016 <- sqrt((exposure_2020$se^2 / (exposure_2020$mean^2 * (1-exposure_2020$mean)^2)) + 
                           (exposure_2016$se^2 / (exposure_2016$mean^2 * (1-exposure_2016$mean)^2)))
or_ci_low_2020_2016 <- exp(log(odds_ratio_2020_2016) - 1.96 * log_or_se_2020_2016)
or_ci_high_2020_2016 <- exp(log(odds_ratio_2020_2016) + 1.96 * log_or_se_2020_2016)

# Population-level estimates (based on ~258.3 million adult Americans)
pop_size <- 258.3e6
pop_exposed_2024 <- exposure_2024$mean * pop_size
pop_exposed_ci_low_2024 <- exposure_2024$low * pop_size
pop_exposed_ci_high_2024 <- exposure_2024$high * pop_size

pop_exposed_2020 <- exposure_2020$mean * pop_size
pop_exposed_ci_low_2020 <- exposure_2020$low * pop_size
pop_exposed_ci_high_2020 <- exposure_2020$high * pop_size

pop_exposed_2016 <- exposure_2016$mean * pop_size
pop_exposed_ci_low_2016 <- exposure_2016$low * pop_size
pop_exposed_ci_high_2016 <- exposure_2016$high * pop_size

```

```{r exposure_comparison_test}
# 2024 vs 2020 comparison
exposure_diff_2024_2020_greater <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024$untrustworthy_flag,
  weight = main_2024$weight,
  y = main_2020$untrustworthy_flag,
  weighty = main_2020$weight,
  alternative = "greater"
)

# Save p-value for multiple testing correction
h1a_p <- exposure_diff_2024_2020_greater$coefficients[3]

# 2024 vs 2020 comparison
exposure_diff_2024_2020_less <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024$untrustworthy_flag,
  weight = main_2024$weight,
  y = main_2020$untrustworthy_flag,
  weighty = main_2020$weight,
  alternative = "less"
)

# Save p-value for multiple testing correction
h1b_p <- exposure_diff_2024_2020_less$coefficients[3]

# 2024 vs 2020 comparison
exposure_diff_2024_2020 <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024$untrustworthy_flag,
  weight = main_2024$weight,
  y = main_2020$untrustworthy_flag,
  weighty = main_2020$weight
)

# 2020 vs 2016 comparison
exposure_diff_2020_2016 <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2020$untrustworthy_flag,
  weight = main_2020$weight,
  y = main_2016$untrustworthy_flag,
  weighty = main_2016$weight
)

# Calculate effect sizes (Cohen's d)
# For 2024 vs 2020
sd_2024 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = main_2024$untrustworthy_flag,
  weights = main_2024$weight
))
sd_2020 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = main_2020$untrustworthy_flag,
  weights = main_2020$weight
))
sd_pooled_2024_2020 <- sqrt((sd_2024^2 + sd_2020^2) / 2)
cohens_d_2024_2020 <- (exposure_diff_2024_2020$additional[["Mean.x"]] - 
                       exposure_diff_2024_2020$additional[["Mean.y"]]) / sd_pooled_2024_2020

# For 2020 vs 2016
sd_2016 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = main_2016$untrustworthy_flag,
  weights = main_2016$weight
))
sd_pooled_2020_2016 <- sqrt((sd_2020^2 + sd_2016^2) / 2)
cohens_d_2020_2016 <- (exposure_diff_2020_2016$additional[["Mean.x"]] - 
                       exposure_diff_2020_2016$additional[["Mean.y"]]) / sd_pooled_2020_2016
```

```{r}
# Extract numeric results for H1a (2024 > 2020)
t_stat_h1a <- exposure_diff_2024_2020_greater$coefficients["t.value"]
df_h1a     <- exposure_diff_2024_2020_greater$coefficients["df"]
p_val_h1a  <- exposure_diff_2024_2020_greater$coefficients["p.value"]
mean_2024  <- exposure_diff_2024_2020_greater$additional[["Mean.x"]]
mean_2020  <- exposure_diff_2024_2020_greater$additional[["Mean.y"]]
diff_means_h1a <- mean_2024 - mean_2020
d_h1a      <- cohens_d_2024_2020  # from your code snippet

# Extract numeric results for H1b (2024 < 2020)
t_stat_h1b <- exposure_diff_2024_2020_less$coefficients["t.value"]
df_h1b     <- exposure_diff_2024_2020_less$coefficients["df"]
p_val_h1b  <- exposure_diff_2024_2020_less$coefficients["p.value"]
# The mean_2024, mean_2020, and diff_means are the same in absolute value
# but the direction of the test changes. We can reuse the same means:
diff_means_h1b <- mean_2024 - mean_2020
d_h1b      <- cohens_d_2024_2020
```

```{r}
# Table for H1a
h1a_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Hypothesis = "H1a: 2024 > 2020",
  `Mean (2024)` = round(mean_2024, 3),
  `Mean (2020)` = round(mean_2020, 3),
  `Difference (2024 - 2020)` = round(diff_means_h1a, 3),
  df = round(df_h1a, 0),
  `t-Statistic` = round(t_stat_h1a, 3),
  `p-Value (one-sided)` = format.pval(p_val_h1a, digits = 3),
  `Cohen's d` = round(d_h1a, 3)
)

knitr::kable(h1a_table, caption = "Hypothesis H1a Results: 2024 > 2020")

# Table for H1b
h1b_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Hypothesis = "H1b: 2024 < 2020",
  `Mean (2024)` = round(mean_2024, 3),
  `Mean (2020)` = round(mean_2020, 3),
  `Difference (2024 - 2020)` = round(diff_means_h1b, 3),
  df = round(df_h1b, 0),
  `t-Statistic` = round(t_stat_h1b, 3),
  `p-Value (one-sided)` = format.pval(p_val_h1b, digits = 3),
  `Cohen's d` = round(d_h1b, 3)
)

knitr::kable(h1b_table, caption = "Hypothesis H1b Results: 2024 < 2020")
```

### 3.1.2 Relative Exposure Measures

```{r relative-exposure-measure1}
# === MEASURE 1: Untrustworthy visits as % of ALL web visits ===
# Uses existing variables: percentage_visits_untrustworthy (2024), percentage_of_total (2020)

# 2024
pct_all_2024 <- tibble(
  mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = main_2024$percentage_visits_untrustworthy, w = main_2024$weight),
  se = diagis::weighted_se(x = main_2024$percentage_visits_untrustworthy, w = main_2024$weight)
) %>% mutate(low = mean - se * 1.96, high = mean + se * 1.96, year = "2024")

# 2020
pct_all_2020 <- tibble(
  mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = main_2020$percentage_of_total, w = main_2020$weight),
  se = diagis::weighted_se(x = main_2020$percentage_of_total, w = main_2020$weight)
) %>% mutate(low = mean - se * 1.96, high = mean + se * 1.96, year = "2020")

# t-test: 2024 vs 2020
pct_all_ttest <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024$percentage_visits_untrustworthy,
  weight = main_2024$weight,
  y = main_2020$percentage_of_total,
  weighty = main_2020$weight
)

# Cohen's d (same method as H1, lines 315-327)
sd_pct_all_2024 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = main_2024$percentage_visits_untrustworthy, weights = main_2024$weight))
sd_pct_all_2020 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = main_2020$percentage_of_total, weights = main_2020$weight))
pooled_sd_pct_all <- sqrt((sd_pct_all_2024^2 + sd_pct_all_2020^2) / 2)
cohens_d_pct_all <- (pct_all_ttest$additional[["Mean.x"]] - pct_all_ttest$additional[["Mean.y"]]) / pooled_sd_pct_all

cat("=== MEASURE 1: % of ALL web visits ===\n")
cat(sprintf("2024: %.4f%% (95%% CI [%.4f%%, %.4f%%])\n",
            pct_all_2024$mean * 100, pct_all_2024$low * 100, pct_all_2024$high * 100))
cat(sprintf("2020: %.4f%% (95%% CI [%.4f%%, %.4f%%])\n",
            pct_all_2020$mean * 100, pct_all_2020$low * 100, pct_all_2020$high * 100))
cat(sprintf("t(%.0f) = %.2f, p = %.4f, Cohen's d = %.3f\n",
            pct_all_ttest$coefficients["df"],
            pct_all_ttest$coefficients["t.value"],
            pct_all_ttest$coefficients["p.value"],
            cohens_d_pct_all))
```


```{r ai-relative-exposure}
# === AI-generated: proportion of all visits and news visits (2024 vs 2020) ===
# percentage_visits_ai_untrustworthy and pct_news_ai_untrustworthy now loaded from CSV

# --- MEASURE 1: AI as % of ALL web visits ---
ai_pct_all_2024 <- tibble(

  se = diagis::weighted_se(x = main_2020$percentage_visits_ai_untrustworthy, w = main_2020$weight)
) %>% mutate(low = mean - se * 1.96, high = mean + se * 1.96, year = "2020")

# t-test: 2024 vs 2020 AI % of all visits

# Cohen's d
sd_ai_pct_all_2024 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = main_2024$percentage_visits_ai_untrustworthy, weights = main_2024$weight))
sd_ai_pct_all_2020 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = main_2020$percentage_visits_ai_untrustworthy, weights = main_2020$weight))
pooled_sd_ai_pct_all <- sqrt((sd_ai_pct_all_2024^2 + sd_ai_pct_all_2020^2) / 2)
cohens_d_ai_pct_all <- (ai_pct_all_ttest$additional[["Mean.x"]] - ai_pct_all_ttest$additional[["Mean.y"]]) / pooled_sd_ai_pct_all

cat("=== AI-GENERATED: % of ALL web visits ===\n")
cat(sprintf("2024: %.4f%% (95%% CI [%.4f%%, %.4f%%])\n",
            ai_pct_all_2024$mean * 100, ai_pct_all_2024$low * 100, ai_pct_all_2024$high * 100))
cat(sprintf("2020: %.4f%% (95%% CI [%.4f%%, %.4f%%])\n",
            ai_pct_all_2020$mean * 100, ai_pct_all_2020$low * 100, ai_pct_all_2020$high * 100))
cat(sprintf("t(%.0f) = %.2f, p = %.4f, Cohen's d = %.3f\n",
            ai_pct_all_ttest$coefficients["df"],
            ai_pct_all_ttest$coefficients["t.value"],
            ai_pct_all_ttest$coefficients["p.value"],
            cohens_d_ai_pct_all))
```

```{r tost-equivalence}
# TOST equivalence tests (Two One-Sided Tests)
# Tests whether 2024-2020 difference is small enough to conclude equivalence

run_tost <- function(tt_result, sd_x, sd_y, label) {
  obs_diff <- tt_result$additional[["Mean.x"]] - tt_result$additional[["Mean.y"]]
  t_val <- tt_result$coefficients["t.value"]
  df <- tt_result$coefficients["df"]
  se_diff <- obs_diff / t_val
  pooled_sd <- sqrt((sd_x^2 + sd_y^2) / 2)

  results <- list()
  for (d_bound in c(0.1, 0.2)) {
    raw_bound <- d_bound * pooled_sd
    t_lower <- (obs_diff + raw_bound) / se_diff
    t_upper <- (obs_diff - raw_bound) / se_diff
    p_lower <- pt(t_lower, df, lower.tail = FALSE)
    p_upper <- pt(t_upper, df, lower.tail = TRUE)
    p_tost <- max(p_lower, p_upper)
    results[[paste0("d_", d_bound)]] <- list(
      p_tost = p_tost, t_lower = t_lower, t_upper = t_upper,
      p_lower = p_lower, p_upper = p_upper
    )
  }

  ci90_low <- obs_diff - qt(0.95, df) * se_diff
  ci90_high <- obs_diff + qt(0.95, df) * se_diff

  cat(sprintf("=== TOST: %s ===\n", label))
  cat(sprintf("df = %.0f\n", df))
  cat(sprintf("90%% CI for d: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", ci90_low/pooled_sd, ci90_high/pooled_sd))
  cat(sprintf("d=±0.1: p = %.4f (%s)\n", results$d_0.1$p_tost,
              ifelse(results$d_0.1$p_tost < 0.05, "equivalent", "not equivalent")))
  cat(sprintf("d=±0.2: p = %.4f (%s)\n", results$d_0.2$p_tost,
              ifelse(results$d_0.2$p_tost < 0.05, "equivalent", "not equivalent")))

  return(results)
}

tost_all <- run_tost(pct_all_ttest, sd_pct_all_2024, sd_pct_all_2020, "% of all visits")
tost_news <- run_tost(pct_news_ttest, sd_pct_news_2024, sd_pct_news_2020, "% of news visits")
```

### 3.1.3 Robustness: Exposure Thresholds

```{r}
# Function to calculate exposure rates for different thresholds
calculate_threshold_exposure <- function(dataset, year_label, threshold) {
  # Create threshold flag
  threshold_flag <- as.integer(dataset$untrustworthy_n >= threshold)

  # Calculate weighted mean and SE using same approach as main analysis
  result <- tibble(
    mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = threshold_flag, w = dataset$weight),
    se = diagis::weighted_se(x = threshold_flag, w = dataset$weight)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      low = mean - se * 1.96,
      high = mean + se * 1.96,
      year = year_label,
      threshold = threshold,
      threshold_label = paste0("≥ ", threshold)
    )

  return(result)
}

# Define thresholds and datasets
thresholds <- c(1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50)
datasets <- list(
  "2016" = main_2016,
  "2020" = main_2020,
  "2024" = main_2024
)

# Calculate exposure rates for all combinations
threshold_results <- map_dfr(names(datasets), function(year) {
  map_dfr(thresholds, function(thresh) {
    calculate_threshold_exposure(datasets[[year]], year, thresh)
  })
})

# View results
print(head(threshold_results, 10))
```

```{r}
# Create weighted t-test comparison table
# Function to calculate weighted t-test between years for specific threshold
calculate_threshold_comparison <- function(thresh) {
  # Filter data for this threshold
  data_2016 <- main_2016 %>% mutate(thresh_flag = as.integer(untrustworthy_n >= thresh))
  data_2020 <- main_2020 %>% mutate(thresh_flag = as.integer(untrustworthy_n >= thresh))
  data_2024 <- main_2024 %>% mutate(thresh_flag = as.integer(untrustworthy_n >= thresh))

  # 2024 vs 2020 test
  test_2024_2020 <- weights::wtd.t.test(
    x = data_2024$thresh_flag, weight = data_2024$weight,
    y = data_2020$thresh_flag, weighty = data_2020$weight
  )

  # 2020 vs 2016 test
  test_2020_2016 <- weights::wtd.t.test(
    x = data_2020$thresh_flag, weight = data_2020$weight,
    y = data_2016$thresh_flag, weighty = data_2016$weight
  )

  # 2024 vs 2016 test
  test_2024_2016 <- weights::wtd.t.test(
    x = data_2024$thresh_flag, weight = data_2024$weight,
    y = data_2016$thresh_flag, weighty = data_2016$weight
  )

  # Extract results
  tibble(
    Threshold = paste0("≥ ", thresh),
    `2024 Mean` = sprintf("%.3f", test_2024_2020$additional[["Mean.x"]]),
    `2020 Mean` = sprintf("%.3f", test_2020_2016$additional[["Mean.x"]]),
    `2016 Mean` = sprintf("%.3f", test_2020_2016$additional[["Mean.y"]]),
    `2024 vs 2020 t(df)` = sprintf("t(%.0f)=%.2f", test_2024_2020$coefficients[["df"]], test_2024_2020$coefficients[["t.value"]]),
    `2024 vs 2020 p` = format.pval(test_2024_2020$coefficients[["p.value"]], digits = 3),
    `2020 vs 2016 t(df)` = sprintf("t(%.0f)=%.2f", test_2020_2016$coefficients[["df"]], test_2020_2016$coefficients[["t.value"]]),
    `2020 vs 2016 p` = format.pval(test_2020_2016$coefficients[["p.value"]], digits = 3),
    `2024 vs 2016 t(df)` = sprintf("t(%.0f)=%.2f", test_2024_2016$coefficients[["df"]], test_2024_2016$coefficients[["t.value"]]),
    `2024 vs 2016 p` = format.pval(test_2024_2016$coefficients[["p.value"]], digits = 3)
  )
}

# Generate comparison table for all thresholds
threshold_comparison_table <- map_dfr(thresholds, calculate_threshold_comparison)

# Display table
knitr::kable(threshold_comparison_table,
             caption = "Weighted T-Test Comparisons Across Exposure Thresholds",
             booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position"))

print("Threshold Robustness Analysis Complete")
```

```{r}
# (3) Run separate weighted t-tests:
# H2a: Test if 2024 > 2020 (i.e., the average number of visits in 2024 is greater than in 2020)

  x = exposed_2024$untrustworthy_n,

  weighty = exposed_2020$weight,
  alternative = "greater"
)

  x = exposed_2024$untrustworthy_n,
  weight = exposed_2024$weight,
  y = exposed_2020$untrustworthy_n,
  weighty = exposed_2020$weight,
  alternative = "less"
)
```

```{r}
mean_2020_intensity <- intensity_diff_greater$additional[["Mean.y"]]
diff_means_intensity <- mean_2024_intensity - mean_2020_intensity

df_h2a     <- round(intensity_diff_greater$coefficients["df"], 0)

t_stat_h2b <- intensity_diff_less$coefficients["t.value"]

df_h2b     <- round(intensity_diff_less$coefficients["df"], 0)
```

```{r}

sd_2020_intensity <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = exposed_2020$untrustworthy_n, weights = exposed_2020$weight))
```

```{r ccdf-visualization}
# Create weighted CCDF calculation function with proper binning
calculate_weighted_ccdf <- function(values, weights, year_label) {
  # Remove missing values and zero values for log scale
  valid_indices <- !is.na(values) & !is.na(weights) & values > 0
  clean_values <- values[valid_indices]
  clean_weights <- weights[valid_indices]

  if (length(clean_values) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(x = numeric(0), ccdf = numeric(0), year = character(0)))
  }

  # Create evenly spaced points on log scale for smooth CCDF
  min_val <- min(clean_values)
  max_val <- max(clean_values)
  x_points <- exp(seq(log(min_val), log(max_val), length.out = 100))

  # Calculate CCDF at each x point
  ccdf_values <- sapply(x_points, function(x) {
    # Calculate weighted proportion of values >= x
    mask <- clean_values >= x
    if (sum(mask) == 0) return(0)
    sum(clean_weights[mask]) / sum(clean_weights)
  })

  # Create result data frame
  result <- data.frame(
    x = x_points,
    ccdf = ccdf_values,
    year = year_label
  ) %>%
    filter(ccdf > 0)  # Remove points where CCDF = 0 for cleaner plot

  return(result)
}

# Calculate CCDF for each year using same data as histogram
ccdf_data <- bind_rows(
  calculate_weighted_ccdf(main_2016$untrustworthy_n, main_2016$weight, "2016"),
  calculate_weighted_ccdf(main_2020$untrustworthy_n, main_2020$weight, "2020"),
  calculate_weighted_ccdf(main_2024$untrustworthy_n, main_2024$weight, "2024")
)

# Create CCDF plot with all years on one panel
intensity_ccdf <- ccdf_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = ccdf, color = year)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Untrustworthy Website Exposures (Log Scale)",
       y = "CCDF: P(X ≥ x)",
       title = "B",
       color = "Election Year") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right") +
  ggsci::scale_color_npg()

intensity_ccdf

# Create alternative combined plot with CCDF
(exposure_plot + intensity_ccdf) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2), guides = "collect") &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5,5,5,5))
```

```{r}
h4_age_ttest_greater <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  weight = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight),
  y = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  weighty = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight),
  alternative = "greater"
)
```

```{r}
# Calculate pooled standard deviation for age groups
sd_65plus <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  weights = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight)
))
sd_under30 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  weights = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight)
))

sd_pooled_age <- sqrt((sd_65plus^2 + sd_under30^2) / 2)
cohens_d_age <- h4_age_ttest_greater$additional["Difference"] / sd_pooled_age

# Extract group means and test statistics
mean_65plus <- round(h4_age_ttest_greater$additional[["Mean.x"]], 3)
mean_under30 <- round(h4_age_ttest_greater$additional[["Mean.y"]], 3)
diff_age <- round(h4_age_ttest_greater$additional["Difference"], 2)
age_t <- round(h4_age_ttest_greater$coefficients["t.value"], 2)
age_df <- round(h4_age_ttest_greater$coefficients["df"], 0)
age_p <- h4_age_ttest_greater$coefficients["p.value"]
```

```{r}
# Create table for H4 results with group means
h4_stats_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Statistic = c("Mean Exposure (65+)", "Mean Exposure (18–29)", "Difference (65+ - 18–29)", "df", "t-value", "p-value", "Cohen's d"),
  `One-Tailed (Greater)` = c(
    mean_65plus,
    mean_under30,
    diff_age,
    age_df,
    age_t,
    ifelse(age_p < 0.001, "< 0.001", format.pval(age_p, digits = 3)),
    round(cohens_d_age, 2)
  )
)
knitr::kable(h4_stats_table, caption = "Table: H4 One-Tailed (Greater) Test Statistics (Adults 65+ vs. 18–29)", format = "markdown")
```

```{r}
main_generation <- main_2016 %>% select(untrustworthy_flag, weight, birthyr, year, untrustworthy_n) %>%
  bind_rows(main_2020 %>% select(untrustworthy_flag, weight, birthyr, year, untrustworthy_n, percentage_of_total, pct_news_untrustworthy)) %>%
  bind_rows(main_2024 %>% select(untrustworthy_flag, weight, birthyr, year, untrustworthy_n, percentage_visits_untrustworthy, pct_news_untrustworthy)) %>%
  mutate(
    generation = case_when(
      birthyr >= 1901 & birthyr <= 1927 ~ "Greatest",
      birthyr >= 1928 & birthyr <= 1945 ~ "Silent",
      birthyr >= 1946 & birthyr <= 1964 ~ "Boomers",
      birthyr >= 1965 & birthyr <= 1980 ~ "Gen X",
      birthyr >= 1981 & birthyr <= 1996 ~ "Millenial",
      birthyr >= 1997 & birthyr <= 2023 ~ "Gen Z"
    ),
    generation = factor(generation, levels = c("Gen Z", "Millenial", "Gen X", "Boomers", "Silent", "Greatest")),
    # Create harmonized percentage variables
    percentage_untrustworthy = case_when(
      year == "2020" ~ percentage_of_total,
      year == "2024" ~ percentage_visits_untrustworthy,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(generation != "Greatest")


generation_exposure <- main_generation %>% 
    group_by(year, generation) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = diagis::weighted_mean(untrustworthy_flag, weight),
    se = diagis::weighted_se(untrustworthy_flag, weight),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    low = mean - 1.96 * se,
    high = mean + 1.96 * se
  )
```

```{r}
# 1. Filter to only 2016, 2020, 2024
main_generation_filtered <- main_generation %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2016, 2020, 2024))

# 2. Format generation_exposure means
generation_exposure_formatted <- generation_exposure %>%
  mutate(
    mean_pct = mean * 100,
    low_pct = low * 100,
    high_pct = high * 100,
    mean_ci = sprintf("%.1f%% [%.1f, %.1f]", mean_pct, low_pct, high_pct) # no % inside brackets
  ) %>%
  select(year, generation, mean_ci) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = mean_ci
  )

# 3. Function to calculate weighted t-test difference
calculate_weighted_diff <- function(gen, year1, year2) {
  temp <- main_generation_filtered %>%
    filter(generation == gen, year %in% c(year1, year2))
  
  if (nrow(temp) == 0) {
    return(tibble(generation = gen, diff = NA_character_))
  }
  
  res <- weights::wtd.t.test(
    x = temp$untrustworthy_flag[temp$year == year2],
    y = temp$untrustworthy_flag[temp$year == year1],
    weight = temp$weight[temp$year == year2],
    weighty = temp$weight[temp$year == year1]
  )
  
  mean_year2 <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = temp$untrustworthy_flag[temp$year == year2], w = temp$weight[temp$year == year2])
  mean_year1 <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = temp$untrustworthy_flag[temp$year == year1], w = temp$weight[temp$year == year1])

  diff_mean <- (mean_year2 - mean_year1) * 100
  t_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["t.value"])
  df_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["df"])
  p_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["p.value"])

  tibble(
    generation = gen,
    diff = sprintf("Diff=%.1f%%, t(%.0f)=%.2f, p=%.3f", diff_mean, df_value, t_value, p_value)
  )
}

# 4. Apply across generations for both comparisons
generations <- unique(main_generation_filtered$generation)

diff_2020_2016 <- map_dfr(generations, ~ calculate_weighted_diff(.x, 2016, 2020)) %>%
  rename(`2020 versus 2016` = diff)

diff_2024_2020 <- map_dfr(generations, ~ calculate_weighted_diff(.x, 2020, 2024)) %>%
  rename(`2024 versus 2020` = diff)

# 5. Merge all into final table
final_table <- generation_exposure_formatted %>%
  left_join(diff_2020_2016, by = "generation") %>%
  left_join(diff_2024_2020, by = "generation") %>%
  select(Generation = generation, `2016`, `2020`, `2024`, `2020 versus 2016`, `2024 versus 2020`)

final_table %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    caption = "Exposure to Untrustworthy Websites by Generation Across 2016, 2020, and 2024 with Weighted T-Test Comparisons",
    align = "lcccc"
  ) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = "scale_down",
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center"
  )
```

```{r}
# Statistical tests for among exposed analysis (all three years)
# Function to calculate weighted t-test for intensity differences
calculate_intensity_diff <- function(gen, year1, year2) {
  temp <- generation_exposed %>%
    filter(generation == gen, year %in% c(year1, year2))

  if (nrow(temp) == 0) {
    return(tibble(generation = gen, diff = NA_character_))
  }

  res <- weights::wtd.t.test(
    x = temp$untrustworthy_n[temp$year == year2],
    y = temp$untrustworthy_n[temp$year == year1],
    weight = temp$weight[temp$year == year2],
    weighty = temp$weight[temp$year == year1]
  )

  mean_year2 <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = temp$untrustworthy_n[temp$year == year2], w = temp$weight[temp$year == year2])
  mean_year1 <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = temp$untrustworthy_n[temp$year == year1], w = temp$weight[temp$year == year1])

  diff_mean <- mean_year2 - mean_year1
  t_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["t.value"])
  df_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["df"])
  p_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["p.value"])

  tibble(
    generation = gen,
    diff = sprintf("Diff=%.1f, t(%.0f)=%.2f, p=%.3f", diff_mean, df_value, t_value, p_value)
  )
}

# Statistical tests for percentage analysis (2020 vs 2024)
calculate_percentage_diff <- function(gen, year1, year2) {
  temp <- main_generation %>%
    filter(!is.na(percentage_untrustworthy), generation == gen, year %in% c(year1, year2))

  if (nrow(temp) == 0) {
    return(tibble(generation = gen, diff = NA_character_))
  }

  res <- weights::wtd.t.test(
    x = temp$percentage_untrustworthy[temp$year == year2],
    y = temp$percentage_untrustworthy[temp$year == year1],
    weight = temp$weight[temp$year == year2],
    weighty = temp$weight[temp$year == year1]
  )

  mean_year2 <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = temp$percentage_untrustworthy[temp$year == year2], w = temp$weight[temp$year == year2])
  mean_year1 <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = temp$percentage_untrustworthy[temp$year == year1], w = temp$weight[temp$year == year1])

  diff_mean <- (mean_year2 - mean_year1) * 100  # Convert to percentage points
  t_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["t.value"])
  df_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["df"])
  p_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["p.value"])

  tibble(
    generation = gen,
    diff = sprintf("Diff=%.2f%%, t(%.0f)=%.2f, p=%.3f", diff_mean, df_value, t_value, p_value)
  )
}

# Apply tests across generations
generations <- unique(generation_exposed$generation)

# Intensity tests
intensity_diff_2020_2016 <- map_dfr(generations, ~ calculate_intensity_diff(.x, 2016, 2020)) %>%
  rename(`Intensity 2020 vs 2016` = diff)

intensity_diff_2024_2020 <- map_dfr(generations, ~ calculate_intensity_diff(.x, 2020, 2024)) %>%
  rename(`Intensity 2024 vs 2020` = diff)

# Percentage tests (only 2020 vs 2024)
percentage_diff_2024_2020 <- map_dfr(generations, ~ calculate_percentage_diff(.x, 2020, 2024)) %>%
  rename(`Percentage 2024 vs 2020` = diff)

# Create expanded summary tables
intensity_table <- generation_intensity %>%
  mutate(
```

```{r}
# Statistical tests and tables following same approach as existing generation analysis

# Function to calculate weighted t-test difference (reusing existing function)
calculate_weighted_diff_generation <- function(gen, year1, year2, variable) {
  if (variable == "untrustworthy_n") {
    # Among exposed analysis
    temp <- main_generation %>%
      filter(generation == gen, year %in% c(year1, year2), untrustworthy_flag == 1)
  } else if (variable == "percentage_untrustworthy") {
    # Percentage of all visits analysis
    temp <- main_generation %>%
      filter(generation == gen, year %in% c(year1, year2), !is.na(percentage_untrustworthy))
  } else if (variable == "pct_news_untrustworthy") {
    # Percentage of news visits analysis
    temp <- main_generation %>%
      filter(generation == gen, year %in% c(year1, year2), !is.na(pct_news_untrustworthy))
  }

  if (nrow(temp) == 0) {
    return(tibble(generation = gen, diff = NA_character_))
  }

  var_data <- temp[[variable]]

  res <- weights::wtd.t.test(
    x = var_data[temp$year == year2],
    y = var_data[temp$year == year1],
    weight = temp$weight[temp$year == year2],
    weighty = temp$weight[temp$year == year1]
  )

  mean_year2 <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = var_data[temp$year == year2], w = temp$weight[temp$year == year2])
  mean_year1 <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = var_data[temp$year == year1], w = temp$weight[temp$year == year1])

  if (variable %in% c("percentage_untrustworthy", "pct_news_untrustworthy")) {
    # Convert to percentage for display
    diff_mean <- (mean_year2 - mean_year1) * 100
    format_str <- "Diff=%.3f%%, t(%.0f)=%.2f, p=%.3f"
  } else {
    # Keep as raw numbers for visit counts
    diff_mean <- mean_year2 - mean_year1
    format_str <- "Diff=%.1f, t(%.0f)=%.2f, p=%.3f"
  }

  t_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["t.value"])
  df_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["df"])
  p_value <- as.numeric(res$coefficients["p.value"])

  tibble(
    generation = gen,
    diff = sprintf(format_str, diff_mean, df_value, t_value, p_value)
  )
}

# Generate tables for intensity (among exposed) analysis
generations <- unique(main_generation$generation)
generations <- generations[!is.na(generations)]

# Format intensity results for table
generation_intensity_formatted <- generation_intensity %>%
  mutate(
    mean_ci = sprintf("%.1f [%.1f, %.1f]", mean, low, high)
  ) %>%
  select(year, generation, mean_ci) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = mean_ci
  )

# Calculate differences for intensity
intensity_diff_2020_2016 <- map_dfr(generations, ~ calculate_weighted_diff_generation(.x, 2016, 2020, "untrustworthy_n")) %>%
  rename(`2020 vs 2016` = diff)

intensity_diff_2024_2020 <- map_dfr(generations, ~ calculate_weighted_diff_generation(.x, 2020, 2024, "untrustworthy_n")) %>%
  rename(`2024 vs 2020` = diff)

# Merge intensity table
intensity_table <- generation_intensity_formatted %>%
  left_join(intensity_diff_2020_2016, by = "generation") %>%
  left_join(intensity_diff_2024_2020, by = "generation") %>%
  select(Generation = generation, `2016`, `2020`, `2024`, `2020 vs 2016`, `2024 vs 2020`)

print("Table: Average Visits Among Exposed by Generation")
print(knitr::kable(intensity_table, caption = "Average Visits Among Those Exposed to Untrustworthy Websites by Generation"))
```

```{r}
h5_ttest <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  weight = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight),
  y = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  weighty = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight),
  alternative = "greater"
)
```

```{r}
# Calculate pooled standard deviation for party groups
sd_rep <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  weights = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight)
))
sd_dem <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  weights = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% drop_na(untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight)
))
sd_pooled_party <- sqrt((sd_rep^2 + sd_dem^2) / 2)
cohens_d_party <- h5_ttest$additional["Difference"] / sd_pooled_party

# Extract group means and test statistics (rounded to 3 decimals)
mean_rep <- round(h5_ttest$additional[["Mean.x"]], 3)
mean_dem <- round(h5_ttest$additional[["Mean.y"]], 3)
diff_party <- round(h5_ttest$additional["Difference"], 3)
party_t <- round(h5_ttest$coefficients["t.value"], 2)
party_df <- round(h5_ttest$coefficients["df"], 0)
party_p <- h5_ttest$coefficients["p.value"]
```

```{r}
# Create table for H5 results
h5_stats_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Statistic = c("Mean Exposure (Republican)", "Mean Exposure (Democrat)", "Difference (Rep - Dem)", "df", "t-value", "p-value", "Cohen's d"),
  `One-Tailed (Greater)` = c(
    mean_rep,
    mean_dem,
    diff_party,
    party_df,
    party_t,
    ifelse(party_p < 0.001, "< 0.001", format.pval(party_p, digits = 3)),
    round(cohens_d_party, 2)
  )
)
knitr::kable(h5_stats_table, caption = "Table: H5 One-Tailed (Greater) Test Statistics (Republican vs. Democrat)", format = "markdown")
```

```{r}
  # 2016 data
```

## 3.8 Vote Choice and Voter Registration Analysis

```{r vote_choice_analysis}
# Vote choice analysis - Trump vs Harris supporters
vote_choice_exposure <- bind_rows(
  # Trump supporters
  tibble(
    group = "Trump Supporters",
    mean = diagis::weighted_mean(
      x = main_2024 %>% filter(trump_supporter == 1) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
      w = main_2024 %>% filter(trump_supporter == 1) %>% pull(weight)
    ),
    se = diagis::weighted_se(
      x = main_2024 %>% filter(trump_supporter == 1) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
      w = main_2024 %>% filter(trump_supporter == 1) %>% pull(weight)
    ),
    n = sum(main_2024$trump_supporter == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  # Harris supporters
  tibble(
    group = "Harris Supporters",
    mean = diagis::weighted_mean(
      x = main_2024 %>% filter(harris_supporter == 1) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
      w = main_2024 %>% filter(harris_supporter == 1) %>% pull(weight)
    ),
    se = diagis::weighted_se(
      x = main_2024 %>% filter(harris_supporter == 1) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
      w = main_2024 %>% filter(harris_supporter == 1) %>% pull(weight)
    ),
    n = sum(main_2024$harris_supporter == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    ci_lower = mean - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = mean + 1.96 * se,
    percentage = mean * 100,
    ci_lower_pct = ci_lower * 100,
    ci_upper_pct = ci_upper * 100
  )

print("Vote Choice Exposure to Untrustworthy Websites (2024):")
print(knitr::kable(vote_choice_exposure %>%
                   select(group, percentage, ci_lower_pct, ci_upper_pct, n) %>%
                   rename("Group" = group, "Exposure %" = percentage,
                          "CI Lower" = ci_lower_pct, "CI Upper" = ci_upper_pct, "N" = n),
                   digits = 1, caption = "Percentage exposed to untrustworthy websites by vote choice"))

# Statistical test with full reporting
trump_exposure <- main_2024 %>% filter(trump_supporter == 1)
harris_exposure <- main_2024 %>% filter(harris_supporter == 1)

vote_choice_test <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = trump_exposure$untrustworthy_flag,
  y = harris_exposure$untrustworthy_flag,
  weight = trump_exposure$weight,
  weighty = harris_exposure$weight
)

# Calculate Cohen's d using Method 1 (Hmisc::wtd.var approach)
sd_trump <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = trump_exposure$untrustworthy_flag,
  weights = trump_exposure$weight
))
sd_harris <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = harris_exposure$untrustworthy_flag,
  weights = harris_exposure$weight
))
pooled_sd <- sqrt((sd_trump^2 + sd_harris^2) / 2)
mean_trump <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = trump_exposure$untrustworthy_flag, w = trump_exposure$weight)
mean_harris <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = harris_exposure$untrustworthy_flag, w = harris_exposure$weight)
cohens_d <- (mean_trump - mean_harris) / pooled_sd

print(paste("Vote Choice Statistical Test:"))
print(paste("Trump supporters: ", round(vote_choice_exposure$percentage[1], 1), "% (95% CI [",
            round(vote_choice_exposure$ci_lower_pct[1], 1), "%, ",
            round(vote_choice_exposure$ci_upper_pct[1], 1), "%])"))
print(paste("Harris supporters: ", round(vote_choice_exposure$percentage[2], 1), "% (95% CI [",
            round(vote_choice_exposure$ci_lower_pct[2], 1), "%, ",
            round(vote_choice_exposure$ci_upper_pct[2], 1), "%])"))
print(paste("t-test: t(", round(vote_choice_test$coefficients[2], 1), ") =", round(vote_choice_test$coefficients[1], 3),
            ", p =", format.pval(vote_choice_test$coefficients[3], digits = 3),
            ", Cohen's d =", round(cohens_d, 3)))
```

```{r voter_registration_analysis}
    ),

  )
) %>%

  )

print("Voter Registration Exposure to Untrustworthy Websites (2024):")

                   select(group, percentage, ci_lower_pct, ci_upper_pct, n) %>%
                   rename("Group" = group, "Exposure %" = percentage,
                          "CI Lower" = ci_lower_pct, "CI Upper" = ci_upper_pct, "N" = n),
                   digits = 1, caption = "Percentage exposed to untrustworthy websites by voter registration"))

# Statistical test with full reporting
registered_data <- main_2024 %>% filter(registered_voter == 1)
nonregistered_data <- main_2024 %>% filter(registered_voter == 0)

voter_reg_test <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = registered_data$untrustworthy_flag,
  y = nonregistered_data$untrustworthy_flag,
  weight = registered_data$weight,
  weighty = nonregistered_data$weight
)

# Calculate Cohen's d using Method 1 (Hmisc::wtd.var approach)
sd_registered <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = registered_data$untrustworthy_flag,
  weights = registered_data$weight
))
sd_nonregistered <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = nonregistered_data$untrustworthy_flag,
  weights = nonregistered_data$weight
))
pooled_sd_voter <- sqrt((sd_registered^2 + sd_nonregistered^2) / 2)
mean_registered <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = registered_data$untrustworthy_flag, w = registered_data$weight)
mean_nonregistered <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = nonregistered_data$untrustworthy_flag, w = nonregistered_data$weight)
cohens_d_voter <- (mean_registered - mean_nonregistered) / pooled_sd_voter

print(paste("Voter Registration Statistical Test:"))
print(paste("Registered voters: ", round(voter_reg_exposure$percentage[1], 1), "% (95% CI [",
            round(voter_reg_exposure$ci_lower_pct[1], 1), "%, ",
            round(voter_reg_exposure$ci_upper_pct[1], 1), "%])"))
print(paste("Non-registered: ", round(voter_reg_exposure$percentage[2], 1), "% (95% CI [",
            round(voter_reg_exposure$ci_lower_pct[2], 1), "%, ",
            round(voter_reg_exposure$ci_upper_pct[2], 1), "%])"))
print(paste("t-test: t(", round(voter_reg_test$coefficients[2], 1), ") =", round(voter_reg_test$coefficients[1], 3),
            ", p =", format.pval(voter_reg_test$coefficients[3], digits = 3),
            ", Cohen's d =", round(cohens_d_voter, 3)))
```

```{r}
# Focus on conservative extremism - compare Very Conservative vs others

    ),

  )
```

```{r}
# Statistical test: Very Conservative vs Conservative
very_conservative_data <- main_2024 %>% filter(ideology == 5 & weight > 0)
conservative_data <- main_2024 %>% filter(ideology == 4 & weight > 0)

test_vc_vs_c <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = very_conservative_data$untrustworthy_flag,
  y = conservative_data$untrustworthy_flag,
  weight = very_conservative_data$weight,
  weighty = conservative_data$weight
)

# Calculate Cohen's d
sd_vc <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = very_conservative_data$untrustworthy_flag,
  weights = very_conservative_data$weight
))
sd_c <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = conservative_data$untrustworthy_flag,
  weights = conservative_data$weight
))
pooled_sd_vc_c <- sqrt((sd_vc^2 + sd_c^2) / 2)
mean_vc <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = very_conservative_data$untrustworthy_flag, w = very_conservative_data$weight)
mean_c <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = conservative_data$untrustworthy_flag, w = conservative_data$weight)
cohens_d_vc_c <- (mean_vc - mean_c) / pooled_sd_vc_c

cat("\n===========================================\n")
cat("Very Conservative vs Conservative (2024)\n")
cat("===========================================\n")
se_vc <- diagis::weighted_se(x = very_conservative_data$untrustworthy_flag, w = very_conservative_data$weight)
se_c <- diagis::weighted_se(x = conservative_data$untrustworthy_flag, w = conservative_data$weight)
cat(sprintf("Very Conservative: %.1f%% (95%% CI [%.1f%%, %.1f%%])\n",
            mean_vc * 100,
            (mean_vc - 1.96 * se_vc) * 100,
            (mean_vc + 1.96 * se_vc) * 100))
cat(sprintf("Conservative: %.1f%% (95%% CI [%.1f%%, %.1f%%])\n",
            mean_c * 100,
            (mean_c - 1.96 * se_c) * 100,
            (mean_c + 1.96 * se_c) * 100))
cat(sprintf("t(%.1f) = %.2f, p %s, Cohen's d = %.2f\n",
            test_vc_vs_c$coefficients[2],
            test_vc_vs_c$coefficients[1],
            ifelse(test_vc_vs_c$coefficients[3] < 0.001, "< 0.001",
                   paste("=", format.pval(test_vc_vs_c$coefficients[3], digits = 3))),
            cohens_d_vc_c))
cat("===========================================\n")
```



```{r ideology_2020_2024_comparison}
# Compare personal ideology between 2020 and 2024
ideology_2020_data <- main_2020 %>%
  filter(!is.na(ideo5) & weight > 0) %>%  # Filter positive weights
  mutate(
    year = "2020",
    # Map 2020 character values to numeric codes
    ideo5_numeric = case_when(
      ideo5 == "Very liberal" ~ 1,
      ideo5 == "Liberal" ~ 2,
      ideo5 == "Moderate" ~ 3,
      ideo5 == "Conservative" ~ 4,
      ideo5 == "Very conservative" ~ 5,
      ideo5 == "Not sure" ~ 6,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    ideology_label = case_when(
      ideo5_numeric == 1 ~ "Very Liberal",
      ideo5_numeric == 2 ~ "Liberal",
      ideo5_numeric == 3 ~ "Moderate",
      ideo5_numeric == 4 ~ "Conservative",
      ideo5_numeric == 5 ~ "Very Conservative",
      ideo5_numeric == 6 ~ "Not Sure",
      TRUE ~ "Missing"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(ideology_label != "Missing") %>%
  group_by(ideo5_numeric, ideology_label, year) %>%
  filter(n() >= 5 & sum(weight > 0) >= 5) %>%  # Ensure sufficient observations
  summarise(
    mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = untrustworthy_flag, w = weight),
    se = diagis::weighted_se(x = untrustworthy_flag, w = weight),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(ideo5 = ideo5_numeric)  # Rename for consistency

ideology_2024_data <- main_2024 %>%
  filter(!is.na(ideology) & weight > 0) %>%  # Filter positive weights
  mutate(
    year = "2024",
    ideo5 = ideology,  # Rename for consistency
    ideology_label = case_when(
      ideology == 1 ~ "Very Liberal",
      ideology == 2 ~ "Liberal",
      ideology == 3 ~ "Moderate",
      ideology == 4 ~ "Conservative",
      ideology == 5 ~ "Very Conservative",
      ideology == 6 ~ "Not Sure",
      TRUE ~ "Missing"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(ideology_label != "Missing") %>%
  group_by(ideo5, ideology_label, year) %>%
  filter(n() >= 5 & sum(weight > 0) >= 5) %>%  # Ensure sufficient observations
  summarise(
    mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = untrustworthy_flag, w = weight),
    se = diagis::weighted_se(x = untrustworthy_flag, w = weight),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Combine data for comparison
ideology_comparison <- bind_rows(ideology_2020_data, ideology_2024_data) %>%
  mutate(
    ci_lower = mean - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = mean + 1.96 * se,
    percentage = mean * 100,
    ci_lower_pct = ci_lower * 100,
    ci_upper_pct = ci_upper * 100
  )

print("Personal Ideology Comparison: 2020 vs 2024")
print(knitr::kable(ideology_comparison %>%
                   select(year, ideology_label, percentage, ci_lower_pct, ci_upper_pct, n) %>%
                   rename("Year" = year, "Ideology" = ideology_label,
                          "Exposure %" = percentage, "CI Lower" = ci_lower_pct,
                          "CI Upper" = ci_upper_pct, "N" = n),
                   digits = 1))

# Statistical tests for each ideology group
ideology_tests <- ideology_comparison %>%
  filter(ideo5 <= 5) %>%  # Exclude "Not Sure"
  group_by(ideo5, ideology_label) %>%
  summarise(
    has_both_years = n() == 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(has_both_years)

# Test each ideology group
for (i in 1:nrow(ideology_tests)) {
  ideo_level <- ideology_tests$ideo5[i]
  ideo_label <- ideology_tests$ideology_label[i]

  # Map numeric back to 2020 character values
  ideo_2020_value <- case_when(
    ideo_level == 1 ~ "Very liberal",
    ideo_level == 2 ~ "Liberal",
    ideo_level == 3 ~ "Moderate",
    ideo_level == 4 ~ "Conservative",
    ideo_level == 5 ~ "Very conservative",
    ideo_level == 6 ~ "Not sure",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  data_2020 <- main_2020 %>% filter(ideo5 == ideo_2020_value & weight > 0)
  data_2024 <- main_2024 %>% filter(ideology == ideo_level & weight > 0)

  test_result <- weights::wtd.t.test(
    x = data_2024$untrustworthy_flag,
    y = data_2020$untrustworthy_flag,
    weight = data_2024$weight,
    weighty = data_2020$weight
  )

  # Calculate Cohen's d using Method 1 (Hmisc::wtd.var approach)
  sd_2024 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
    x = data_2024$untrustworthy_flag,
    weights = data_2024$weight
  ))
  sd_2020 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
    x = data_2020$untrustworthy_flag,
    weights = data_2020$weight
  ))
  pooled_sd <- sqrt((sd_2024^2 + sd_2020^2) / 2)
  mean_2024 <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = data_2024$untrustworthy_flag, w = data_2024$weight)
  mean_2020 <- diagis::weighted_mean(x = data_2020$untrustworthy_flag, w = data_2020$weight)
  cohens_d <- (mean_2024 - mean_2020) / pooled_sd

  # Get exposure rates and CIs from comparison table
  stats_2020 <- ideology_comparison %>% filter(year == "2020" & ideo5 == ideo_level)
  stats_2024 <- ideology_comparison %>% filter(year == "2024" & ideo5 == ideo_level)

  # Calculate percentage point change
  pp_change <- stats_2024$percentage - stats_2020$percentage

  # Print formatted output matching main-text.md style
  cat("\n===========================================\n")
  cat(ideo_label, "- Temporal Comparison (2020 vs 2024)\n")
  cat("===========================================\n")
  cat(sprintf("2020: %.1f%% (95%% CI [%.1f%%, %.1f%%])\n",
              stats_2020$percentage, stats_2020$ci_lower_pct, stats_2020$ci_upper_pct))
  cat(sprintf("2024: %.1f%% (95%% CI [%.1f%%, %.1f%%])\n",
              stats_2024$percentage, stats_2024$ci_lower_pct, stats_2024$ci_upper_pct))
  cat(sprintf("Change: %.1f percentage points\n", pp_change))
  cat(sprintf("t(%.0f) = %.2f, p %s, Cohen's d = %.2f\n",
              test_result$coefficients[2],
              test_result$coefficients[1],
              ifelse(test_result$coefficients[3] < 0.001, "< 0.001",
                     paste("=", format.pval(test_result$coefficients[3], digits = 3))),
              cohens_d))
  cat("===========================================\n")
}
```

REFERRAL DATA REQUIRES INDIVIDUAL-VISIT DATA WHICH ARE NOT AVAILABLE TO MAINTAIN PARTICIPANT PRIVACY.

# 4. RQ2: AI-Generated Untrustworthy Website in 2024

## 4.1 AI Exposure Rates (H7)

```{r}
# Calculate weighted exposure rate for AI-generated misinformation websites in 2024
ai_exposure_2024 <- tibble::tibble(
  mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = main_2024$ai_untrustworthy_flag, w = main_2024$weight),
  se = diagis::weighted_se(x = main_2024$ai_untrustworthy_flag, w = main_2024$weight)
) %>% mutate(
  low = mean - se * 1.96,
  high = mean + se * 1.96,
  year = "2024"
)

# Calculate weighted exposure rate for AI-generated misinformation websites in 2020
ai_exposure_2020 <- tibble::tibble(
  mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = main_2020$ai_untrustworthy_flag, w = main_2020$weight),
  se = diagis::weighted_se(x = main_2020$ai_untrustworthy_flag, w = main_2020$weight)
) %>% mutate(
  low = mean - se * 1.96,
  high = mean + se * 1.96,
  year = "2020"
)
```

```{r ai_exposure_comparison_test}
# Run a one-sided weighted t-test comparing AI exposure rates in 2024 vs. 2020
ai_exposure_diff <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024$ai_untrustworthy_flag,
  weight = main_2024$weight,
  y = main_2020$ai_untrustworthy_flag,
  weighty = main_2020$weight,
  alternative = "greater"
)

# Save p-value for multiple testing correction
h7_p <- ai_exposure_diff$coefficients[3]
```

```{r}
# Calculate the absolute difference, its standard error, and 95% CI for the difference
abs_diff_ai <- ai_exposure_2024$mean - ai_exposure_2020$mean
abs_diff_se_ai <- sqrt(ai_exposure_2024$se^2 + ai_exposure_2020$se^2)
abs_diff_ci_low_ai <- abs_diff_ai - 1.96 * abs_diff_se_ai
abs_diff_ci_high_ai <- abs_diff_ai + 1.96 * abs_diff_se_ai

# Calculate pooled standard deviation and Cohen's d for H7
sd_2024_ai <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = main_2024$ai_untrustworthy_flag, weights = main_2024$weight))
sd_2020_ai <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = main_2020$ai_untrustworthy_flag, weights = main_2020$weight))
sd_pooled_ai <- sqrt((sd_2024_ai^2 + sd_2020_ai^2) / 2)
cohens_d_ai <- (ai_exposure_diff$additional[["Mean.x"]] - ai_exposure_diff$additional[["Mean.y"]]) / sd_pooled_ai

```

```{r}
# Create table for H7 results with 95% CIs
ai_exposure_stats_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Statistic = c("2024 AI Exposure Rate", "2020 AI Exposure Rate",
                "Difference (2024 - 2020)",
                "df", "t-Statistic", "p-value (one-sided)", "Cohen's d"),
  Value = c(
    paste0(scales::percent(ai_exposure_2024$mean, accuracy = 0.1), " (95% CI: [",
           scales::percent(ai_exposure_2024$low, accuracy = 0.1), ", ",
           scales::percent(ai_exposure_2024$high, accuracy = 0.1), "])"),
    paste0(scales::percent(ai_exposure_2020$mean, accuracy = 0.1), " (95% CI: [",
           scales::percent(ai_exposure_2020$low, accuracy = 0.1), ", ",
           scales::percent(ai_exposure_2020$high, accuracy = 0.1), "])"),
    paste0(scales::percent(abs_diff_ai, accuracy = 0.1), " (95% CI: [",
           scales::percent(abs_diff_ci_low_ai, accuracy = 0.1), ", ",
           scales::percent(abs_diff_ci_high_ai, accuracy = 0.1), "])"),
    as.character(round(ai_exposure_diff$coefficients["df"], 0)),
    round(ai_exposure_diff$coefficients["t.value"], 2),
    ifelse(ai_exposure_diff$coefficients["p.value"] < 0.001, "< 0.001", format.pval(ai_exposure_diff$coefficients["p.value"], digits = 3)),
    round(cohens_d_ai, 3)
  )
)

knitr::kable(ai_exposure_stats_table, 
             caption = "Table: H7 Weighted Test Statistics for AI-Generated Misinformation Website Exposure with 95% CIs", 
             format = "markdown")
```

## 4.2 AI Content Proportion (H8)

Note: UAINS and DNRPFC are mutually exclusive (i.e., no domains in our data overlap between the two categories). 

```{r}
# Calculate proportion of AI content among untrustworthy sites for 2024
ai_proportion_2024 <- main_2024 %>%
  summarise(
    total_untrustworthy = sum(untrustworthy_n * weight + ai_untrustworthy_n * weight),
    ai_untrustworthy = sum(ai_untrustworthy_n * weight),
    proportion = ai_untrustworthy / total_untrustworthy,
    se = sqrt((proportion * (1 - proportion)) / total_untrustworthy),
    low = proportion - 1.96 * se,
    high = proportion + 1.96 * se
  )

# Calculate proportion of AI content among untrustworthy sites for 2020
ai_proportion_2020 <- main_2020 %>%
  summarise(
    total_untrustworthy = sum(untrustworthy_n * weight + ai_untrustworthy_n * weight),
    ai_untrustworthy = sum(ai_untrustworthy_n * weight),
    proportion = ai_untrustworthy / total_untrustworthy,
    se = sqrt((proportion * (1 - proportion)) / total_untrustworthy),
    low = proportion - 1.96 * se,
    high = proportion + 1.96 * se
  )

# One-sided weighted proportion test (alternative = "greater")
prop_test_one <- prop.test(
  x = c(ai_proportion_2024$ai_untrustworthy, ai_proportion_2020$ai_untrustworthy),
  n = c(ai_proportion_2024$total_untrustworthy, ai_proportion_2020$total_untrustworthy),
  alternative = "greater"
)

# Save p-value for multiple testing correction
h8_p <- prop_test_one$p.value

# Two-sided weighted proportion test
prop_test_two <- prop.test(
  x = c(ai_proportion_2024$ai_untrustworthy, ai_proportion_2020$ai_untrustworthy),
  n = c(ai_proportion_2024$total_untrustworthy, ai_proportion_2020$total_untrustworthy),
  alternative = "two.sided"
)

# Extract proportions and convert to percentages with one decimal place
p1 <- ai_proportion_2024$proportion
p2 <- ai_proportion_2020$proportion

# Group-level 95% CIs as percentages
ci_2024_group <- paste0("[", scales::percent(ai_proportion_2024$low, accuracy = 0.1),
                        ", ", scales::percent(ai_proportion_2024$high, accuracy = 0.1), "]")
ci_2020_group <- paste0("[", scales::percent(ai_proportion_2020$low, accuracy = 0.1),
                        ", ", scales::percent(ai_proportion_2020$high, accuracy = 0.1), "]")

# One-sided test: extract difference CI and other stats
diff_one_low <- round(prop_test_one$conf.int[1], 3)
diff_one_high <- round(prop_test_one$conf.int[2], 3)
diff_one <- round(p1 - p2, 3)
chi_sq_one <- round(prop_test_one$statistic, 2)
df_one <- prop_test_one$parameter
p_one <- prop_test_one$p.value

# Two-sided test: extract difference CI and other stats
diff_two_low <- round(prop_test_two$conf.int[1], 3)
diff_two_high <- round(prop_test_two$conf.int[2], 3)
diff_two <- round(p1 - p2, 3)  # should be same as one-sided difference
chi_sq_two <- round(prop_test_two$statistic, 2)
df_two <- prop_test_two$parameter
p_two <- prop_test_two$p.value

# Calculate Cohen's h for effect size
cohens_h <- round(2 * (asin(sqrt(p1)) - asin(sqrt(p2))), 3)

# Calculate relative ratio and its 95% CI using log transformation
relative_ratio_prop <- p1 / p2
log_ratio_prop <- log(relative_ratio_prop)
se_log_ratio_prop <- sqrt((ai_proportion_2024$se / p1)^2 + (ai_proportion_2020$se / p2)^2)
ratio_ci_low <- exp(log_ratio_prop - 1.96 * se_log_ratio_prop)
ratio_ci_high <- exp(log_ratio_prop + 1.96 * se_log_ratio_prop)

# Create comprehensive summary table combining one-sided and two-sided results
ai_proportion_stats_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Measure = c(
    "2024 AI Content Proportion",
    "2020 AI Content Proportion",
    "Absolute Difference",
    "Relative Ratio",
    "Cohen's h",
    "df",
    "Chi-squared",
    "p-value"
  ),
  `One-Sided` = c(
    paste0(scales::percent(p1, accuracy = 0.1), " ", ci_2024_group),
    paste0(scales::percent(p2, accuracy = 0.1), " ", ci_2020_group),
    paste0(scales::percent(diff_one, accuracy = 0.1), " (95% CI: [", scales::percent(diff_one_low, accuracy = 0.1), ", ", scales::percent(diff_one_high, accuracy = 0.1), "])"),
    paste0(round(relative_ratio_prop, 2), "x (95% CI: [", round(ratio_ci_low, 2), ", ", round(ratio_ci_high, 2), "])"),
    as.character(cohens_h),
    as.character(df_one),
    as.character(chi_sq_one),
    format.pval(p_one, digits = 3)
  ),
  `Two-Sided` = c(
    paste0(scales::percent(p1, accuracy = 0.1), " ", ci_2024_group),
    paste0(scales::percent(p2, accuracy = 0.1), " ", ci_2020_group),
    paste0(scales::percent(diff_two, accuracy = 0.1), " (95% CI: [", scales::percent(diff_two_low, accuracy = 0.1), ", ", scales::percent(diff_two_high, accuracy = 0.1), "])"),
    paste0(round(relative_ratio_prop, 2), "x (95% CI: [", round(ratio_ci_low, 2), ", ", round(ratio_ci_high, 2), "])"),
    as.character(cohens_h),
    as.character(df_two),
    as.character(chi_sq_two),
    format.pval(p_two, digits = 3)
  )
)

knitr::kable(ai_proportion_stats_table, 
             caption = "Table: AI-Generated Content as a Proportion of All Untrustworthy Content (H8)", 
             align = c("l", "r", "r"),
             booktabs = TRUE, 
             format = "markdown")

# Create a table for the raw weighted counts
ai_proportion_counts_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Measure = c(
    "2024 AI-Generated Visits (Weighted)",
    "2024 Total Untrustworthy Visits (Weighted)",
    "2020 AI-Generated Visits (Weighted)",
    "2020 Total Untrustworthy Visits (Weighted)"
  ),
  Value = c(
    format(round(ai_proportion_2024$ai_untrustworthy), big.mark = ","),
    format(round(ai_proportion_2024$total_untrustworthy), big.mark = ","),
    format(round(ai_proportion_2020$ai_untrustworthy), big.mark = ","),
    format(round(ai_proportion_2020$total_untrustworthy), big.mark = ",")
  )
)

knitr::kable(ai_proportion_counts_table,
             caption = "Table: Visit Counts for AI Proportion Analysis (H8)", 
             align = c("l", "r"), 
             booktabs = TRUE, 
             format = "markdown")
```

```{r talk_ai_demographic_contrast}
# ── Figure: Demographic Contrast — Non-AI vs AI Exposure (for talks) ──────
# Recompute all 8 data points fresh to avoid variable-name collisions

# Helper: compute weighted mean + SE for a subgroup
talk_compute_exposure <- function(data, group_filter, outcome_var) {
  sub <- data %>% filter(!!rlang::sym(group_filter) == 1)
  tibble(
    wmean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = sub[[outcome_var]], w = sub$weight),
    wse   = diagis::weighted_se(x = sub[[outcome_var]], w = sub$weight)
  )
}

# Age: 65+ and 18-29 × Non-AI and AI
talk_age65_nonai <- talk_compute_exposure(main_2024, "age_65_plus", "untrustworthy_flag")
talk_age65_ai    <- talk_compute_exposure(main_2024, "age_65_plus", "ai_untrustworthy_flag")
talk_age18_nonai <- talk_compute_exposure(main_2024, "age_18_29",   "untrustworthy_flag")
talk_age18_ai    <- talk_compute_exposure(main_2024, "age_18_29",   "ai_untrustworthy_flag")

# Party: Republican and Democrat × Non-AI and AI
talk_rep_nonai <- talk_compute_exposure(main_2024, "republican", "untrustworthy_flag")
talk_rep_ai    <- talk_compute_exposure(main_2024, "republican", "ai_untrustworthy_flag")
talk_dem_nonai <- talk_compute_exposure(main_2024, "democrat",   "untrustworthy_flag")
talk_dem_ai    <- talk_compute_exposure(main_2024, "democrat",   "ai_untrustworthy_flag")

talk_demo_data <- tribble(
  ~panel,  ~group,       ~type,                        ~wmean,                  ~wse,
  "Age",   "65+",        "Non-AI\nUntrustworthy",      talk_age65_nonai$wmean,  talk_age65_nonai$wse,
  "Age",   "65+",        "AI-Generated\nUntrustworthy", talk_age65_ai$wmean,    talk_age65_ai$wse,
  "Age",   "18-29",      "Non-AI\nUntrustworthy",      talk_age18_nonai$wmean,  talk_age18_nonai$wse,
  "Age",   "18-29",      "AI-Generated\nUntrustworthy", talk_age18_ai$wmean,    talk_age18_ai$wse,
  "Party", "Republican",  "Non-AI\nUntrustworthy",      talk_rep_nonai$wmean,   talk_rep_nonai$wse,
  "Party", "Republican",  "AI-Generated\nUntrustworthy", talk_rep_ai$wmean,     talk_rep_ai$wse,
  "Party", "Democrat",    "Non-AI\nUntrustworthy",      talk_dem_nonai$wmean,   talk_dem_nonai$wse,
  "Party", "Democrat",    "AI-Generated\nUntrustworthy", talk_dem_ai$wmean,     talk_dem_ai$wse
) %>%
  mutate(low  = wmean - 1.96 * wse,
         high = wmean + 1.96 * wse,
         type = factor(type, levels = c("Non-AI\nUntrustworthy", "AI-Generated\nUntrustworthy")))

# ── Significance tests: weighted t-tests for each within-type comparison ──
# Age: 65+ vs 18-29, Non-AI
talk_ttest_age_nonai <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  y = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  weight = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% pull(weight),
  weighty = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% pull(weight)
)
# Age: 65+ vs 18-29, AI
talk_ttest_age_ai <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  y = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  weight = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% pull(weight),
  weighty = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% pull(weight)
)
# Party: Rep vs Dem, Non-AI
talk_ttest_party_nonai <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  y = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% pull(untrustworthy_flag),
  weight = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% pull(weight),
  weighty = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% pull(weight)
)
# Party: Rep vs Dem, AI
talk_ttest_party_ai <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  y = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  weight = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% pull(weight),
  weighty = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% pull(weight)
)

# Format p-values for display
talk_format_p <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) return("p < .001")
  if (p < 0.01)  return(paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  if (p < 0.05)  return(paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 2)))
  return(paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 2)))
}

talk_p_age_nonai  <- talk_format_p(talk_ttest_age_nonai$coefficients["p.value"])
talk_p_age_ai     <- talk_format_p(talk_ttest_age_ai$coefficients["p.value"])
talk_p_party_nonai <- talk_format_p(talk_ttest_party_nonai$coefficients["p.value"])
talk_p_party_ai   <- talk_format_p(talk_ttest_party_ai$coefficients["p.value"])

# Bracket y-positions: just above the highest CI at each x-position
talk_age_data <- talk_demo_data %>% filter(panel == "Age")
talk_party_data <- talk_demo_data %>% filter(panel == "Party")

talk_bracket_age_nonai_y <- max(talk_age_data %>% filter(type == "Non-AI\nUntrustworthy") %>% pull(high)) * 1.10
talk_bracket_age_ai_y    <- max(talk_age_data %>% filter(type == "AI-Generated\nUntrustworthy") %>% pull(high)) * 1.10
talk_bracket_party_nonai_y <- max(talk_party_data %>% filter(type == "Non-AI\nUntrustworthy") %>% pull(high)) * 1.10
talk_bracket_party_ai_y    <- max(talk_party_data %>% filter(type == "AI-Generated\nUntrustworthy") %>% pull(high)) * 1.10

# Age panel: x = content type, color = age group
talk_age_panel <- ggplot(talk_age_data,
       aes(x = type, y = wmean, ymin = low, ymax = high, color = group)) +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 1, fatten = 3) +
  geom_signif(
    annotations = c(talk_p_age_nonai, talk_p_age_ai),
    xmin = c(0.875, 1.875), xmax = c(1.125, 2.125),
    y_position = c(talk_bracket_age_nonai_y, talk_bracket_age_ai_y),
    tip_length = 0.015, textsize = 4.5, color = "grey60"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("65+" = "black", "18-29" = "grey50")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Percentage Exposed", title = "", color = "Age")

# Party panel: x = content type, color = party
talk_party_panel <- ggplot(talk_party_data,
       aes(x = type, y = wmean, ymin = low, ymax = high, color = group)) +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 1, fatten = 3) +
  geom_signif(
    annotations = c(talk_p_party_nonai, talk_p_party_ai),
    xmin = c(0.875, 1.875), xmax = c(1.125, 2.125),
    y_position = c(talk_bracket_party_nonai_y, talk_bracket_party_ai_y),
    tip_length = 0.015, textsize = 4.5, color = "grey60"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Republican" = "black", "Democrat" = "grey50")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Percentage Exposed", title = "", color = "Party")

(talk_age_panel | talk_party_panel) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A', theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")))

ggsave("../figures/ai_demographic_contrast.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
```


## 4.3 AI Time Spent Analysis (H9)

DURATION DATA REQUIRES INDIVIDUAL-VISIT DATA WHICH ARE NOT AVAILABLE TO MAINTAIN PARTICIPANT PRIVACY.

## 4.4 Demographic Factors

### 4.4.1 Age (H10)

```{r}
# Run one-sided weighted t-test for AI-generated misinformation exposure between age groups (per-visit)
h10_age_ttest <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% drop_na(ai_untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  weight = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% drop_na(ai_untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight),
  y = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% drop_na(ai_untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  weighty = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% drop_na(ai_untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight),
  alternative = "greater"
)

# Means (proportions) and SEs
mean_65_prop <- as.numeric(h10_age_ttest$additional[["Mean.x"]])
mean_18_prop <- as.numeric(h10_age_ttest$additional[["Mean.y"]])
se_65 <- diagis::weighted_se(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  w = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% pull(weight)
)
se_18 <- diagis::weighted_se(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  w = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% pull(weight)
)

# Compute CIs for each group and convert everything to percentages
mean_65 <- round(mean_65_prop * 100, 1)
mean_18 <- round(mean_18_prop * 100, 1)
ci_65_low <- round((mean_65_prop - 1.96 * se_65) * 100, 1)
ci_65_high <- round((mean_65_prop + 1.96 * se_65) * 100, 1)
ci_18_low <- round((mean_18_prop - 1.96 * se_18) * 100, 1)
ci_18_high <- round((mean_18_prop + 1.96 * se_18) * 100, 1)

# Difference CI
diff_val <- round(as.numeric(h10_age_ttest$additional["Difference"]) * 100, 1)
se_val <- round(as.numeric(h10_age_ttest$additional["Std. Err"]) * 100, 1)
ci_low <- round(diff_val - 1.96 * se_val, 1)
ci_high <- round(diff_val + 1.96 * se_val, 1)

# t, df, and p
t_val <- round(h10_age_ttest$coefficients["t.value"], 2)
df_val <- round(h10_age_ttest$coefficients["df"], 0)
p_val <- h10_age_ttest$coefficients["p.value"]

# Pooled SD and Cohen's d
sd_65_ai <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  weights = main_2024 %>% filter(age_65_plus == 1) %>% pull(weight)
))
sd_18_ai <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  weights = main_2024 %>% filter(age_18_29 == 1) %>% pull(weight)
))
sd_pooled_ai <- sqrt((sd_65_ai^2 + sd_18_ai^2) / 2)
cohens_d_ai <- ifelse(sd_pooled_ai == 0 | is.na(sd_pooled_ai), NA, round(as.numeric(h10_age_ttest$additional["Difference"]) / sd_pooled_ai, 3))

# Final summary table with CIs in a second column
h10_stats_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Statistic = c(
    "Mean Exposure (65+)",
    "Mean Exposure (18–29)",
    "Difference (65+ - 18–29)",
    "df",
    "t-value",
    "p-value",
    "SE",
    "Cohen's d"
  ),
  `Value` = c(
    paste0(mean_65, "%"),
    paste0(mean_18, "%"),
    paste0(diff_val, "%"),
    as.character(df_val),
    t_val,
    ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "< 0.001", format.pval(p_val, digits = 3)),
    paste0(se_val, "%"),
    cohens_d_ai
  ),
  `95% CI` = c(
    paste0("[", ci_65_low, "%, ", ci_65_high, "%]"),
    paste0("[", ci_18_low, "%, ", ci_18_high, "%]"),
    paste0("[", ci_low, "%, ", ci_high, "%]"),
    NA, NA, NA, NA, NA
  )
)

knitr::kable(h10_stats_table, 
             caption = "H10: One-Tailed Test Comparing Exposure to AI-Generated Untrustworthy Websites (65+ vs. 18–29) with 95% Confidence Intervals", 
             format = "markdown")
```


### 4.4.2 Party Identification (H11)

```{r}
# Run one-sided weighted t-test for AI-generated misinformation exposure: Republicans > Democrats
h11_party_ttest <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% drop_na(ai_untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  weight = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% drop_na(ai_untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight),
  y = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% drop_na(ai_untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  weighty = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% drop_na(ai_untrustworthy_flag, weight) %>% pull(weight),
  alternative = "greater"
)

# Means (proportions) and SEs
mean_rep_prop <- as.numeric(h11_party_ttest$additional[["Mean.x"]])
mean_dem_prop <- as.numeric(h11_party_ttest$additional[["Mean.y"]])

se_rep <- diagis::weighted_se(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  w = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% pull(weight)
)

se_dem <- diagis::weighted_se(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  w = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% pull(weight)
)

# Compute group means and 95% CIs (in %)
mean_rep <- round(mean_rep_prop * 100, 1)
mean_dem <- round(mean_dem_prop * 100, 1)
ci_rep_low <- round((mean_rep_prop - 1.96 * se_rep) * 100, 1)
ci_rep_high <- round((mean_rep_prop + 1.96 * se_rep) * 100, 1)
ci_dem_low <- round((mean_dem_prop - 1.96 * se_dem) * 100, 1)
ci_dem_high <- round((mean_dem_prop + 1.96 * se_dem) * 100, 1)

# Difference, SE, and CI
diff_val <- round(as.numeric(h11_party_ttest$additional["Difference"]) * 100, 1)
se_val <- round(as.numeric(h11_party_ttest$additional["Std. Err"]) * 100, 1)
ci_low <- round(diff_val - 1.96 * se_val, 1)
ci_high <- round(diff_val + 1.96 * se_val, 1)

# t, df, and p
t_val <- round(h11_party_ttest$coefficients["t.value"], 2)
df_val <- round(h11_party_ttest$coefficients["df"], 0)
p_val <- h11_party_ttest$coefficients["p.value"]

# Pooled SD and Cohen's d
sd_rep <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  weights = main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>% pull(weight)
))
sd_dem <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(
  x = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% pull(ai_untrustworthy_flag),
  weights = main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>% pull(weight)
))
sd_pooled_party_ai <- sqrt((sd_rep^2 + sd_dem^2) / 2)
cohens_d_party_ai <- round(as.numeric(h11_party_ttest$additional["Difference"]) / sd_pooled_party_ai, 3)

# Final summary table with values and 95% CIs
h11_stats_table <- tibble::tibble(
  Statistic = c(
    "Mean Exposure (Republican)",
    "Mean Exposure (Democrat)",
    "Difference (Rep - Dem)",
    "df",
    "t-value",
    "p-value",
    "SE",
    "Cohen's d"
  ),
  `Value` = c(
    paste0(mean_rep, "%"),
    paste0(mean_dem, "%"),
    paste0(diff_val, "%"),
    as.character(df_val),
    t_val,
    ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "< 0.001", format.pval(p_val, digits = 3)),
    paste0(se_val, "%"),
    cohens_d_party_ai
  ),
  `95% CI` = c(
    paste0("[", ci_rep_low, "%, ", ci_rep_high, "%]"),
    paste0("[", ci_dem_low, "%, ", ci_dem_high, "%]"),
    paste0("[", ci_low, "%, ", ci_high, "%]"),
    NA, NA, NA, NA, NA
  )
)

knitr::kable(h11_stats_table,
             caption = "H11: One-Tailed Test Comparing Exposure to AI-Generated Untrustworthy Websites (Republicans vs. Democrats) with 95% Confidence Intervals",
             format = "markdown")
```

## 4.5 Combined General + AI Untrustworthy Exposure (S26)

The general untrustworthy (2,573 domains) and AI-generated untrustworthy (810 UAINS domains) lists are mutually exclusive — no domain appears on both lists. This chunk computes topline metrics for the combined list to show what exposure looks like when both categories are pooled.

```{r combined_any_exposure_metrics}
# ── Combined (General + AI) Untrustworthy Exposure Metrics ──────────────────
# For SM S26: Domain list overlap clarification

# --- 2024 ---

# 1. % exposed (combined)
combined_exposure_2024 <- tibble::tibble(
  mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = main_2024$combined_any_flag, w = main_2024$weight),
  se = diagis::weighted_se(x = main_2024$combined_any_flag, w = main_2024$weight)
) %>% mutate(low = mean - se * 1.96, high = mean + se * 1.96)

# 2. Intensity among exposed (combined)
exposed_combined_2024 <- main_2024 %>% filter(combined_any_flag == 1)
combined_intensity_2024 <- tibble::tibble(
  mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = exposed_combined_2024$combined_any_n, w = exposed_combined_2024$weight),
  se = diagis::weighted_se(x = exposed_combined_2024$combined_any_n, w = exposed_combined_2024$weight)
) %>% mutate(low = mean - se * 1.96, high = mean + se * 1.96)

# 3. % of all visits (combined)
combined_pct_all_2024 <- tibble::tibble(
  mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = main_2024$percentage_visits_combined_any, w = main_2024$weight),
  se = diagis::weighted_se(x = main_2024$percentage_visits_combined_any, w = main_2024$weight)
) %>% mutate(low = mean - se * 1.96, high = mean + se * 1.96)

  se = diagis::weighted_se(x = main_2024$pct_news_combined_any, w = main_2024$weight)
) %>% mutate(low = mean - se * 1.96, high = mean + se * 1.96)

# --- 2020 ---

# 1. % exposed (combined)
combined_exposure_2020 <- tibble::tibble(

) %>% mutate(low = mean - se * 1.96, high = mean + se * 1.96)

# 3. % of all visits (combined)

  se = diagis::weighted_se(x = main_2020$percentage_visits_combined_any, w = main_2020$weight)
) %>% mutate(low = mean - se * 1.96, high = mean + se * 1.96)

  Year = c(rep("2024", 4), rep("2020", 4)),

    paste0("[", sprintf("%.2f%%", combined_pct_news_2020$low * 100), ", ", sprintf("%.2f%%", combined_pct_news_2020$high * 100), "]")
  )
)

knitr::kable(combined_any_summary,
```
