## 8.2 Pre-Election vs. Post-Election Statistical Analysis

```{r pre_post_analysis}
# Create pre/post period analysis for 2024
pre_post_data_2024 <- daily_exposure_2024 %>%
  filter(day_relative_to_election != 0) %>%  # Exclude Election Day
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      day_relative_to_election < 0 ~ "Pre-Election",
      day_relative_to_election > 0 ~ "Post-Election"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(period))

# Create pre/post period analysis for 2020
pre_post_data_2020 <- daily_exposure_2020 %>%
  filter(day_relative_to_election != 0) %>%  # Exclude Election Day
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      day_relative_to_election < 0 ~ "Pre-Election",
      day_relative_to_election > 0 ~ "Post-Election"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(period))

# Overall pre/post comparison for 2024
overall_pre_post_2024 <- pre_post_data_2024 %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = untrustworthy_flag_daily, w = weight),
    se = diagis::weighted_se(x = untrustworthy_flag_daily, w = weight),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = mean * 100,
    ci_lower = (mean - 1.96 * se) * 100,
    ci_upper = (mean + 1.96 * se) * 100,
    year = "2024"
  )

# Overall pre/post comparison for 2020
overall_pre_post_2020 <- pre_post_data_2020 %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = untrustworthy_flag_daily, w = weight),
    se = diagis::weighted_se(x = untrustworthy_flag_daily, w = weight),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = mean * 100,
    ci_lower = (mean - 1.96 * se) * 100,
    ci_upper = (mean + 1.96 * se) * 100,
    year = "2020"
  )

# Combine both years for comparison
overall_pre_post_combined <- bind_rows(overall_pre_post_2020, overall_pre_post_2024)

print("Overall Pre-Election vs. Post-Election Exposure:")
print("2024 Data:")
print(knitr::kable(overall_pre_post_2024 %>% select(-year), digits = 2))
print("2020 Data:")
print(knitr::kable(overall_pre_post_2020 %>% select(-year), digits = 2))

# Statistical tests for 2024
pre_data_2024 <- pre_post_data_2024 %>% filter(period == "Pre-Election")
post_data_2024 <- pre_post_data_2024 %>% filter(period == "Post-Election")

test_2024 <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = post_data_2024$untrustworthy_flag_daily,
  y = pre_data_2024$untrustworthy_flag_daily,
  weight = post_data_2024$weight,
  weighty = pre_data_2024$weight
)

# Calculate Cohen's d for 2024 (Method 1: Hmisc::wtd.var pooled SD)
sd_post_2024 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = post_data_2024$untrustworthy_flag_daily, weights = post_data_2024$weight))
sd_pre_2024 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = pre_data_2024$untrustworthy_flag_daily, weights = pre_data_2024$weight))
pooled_sd_2024 <- sqrt((sd_post_2024^2 + sd_pre_2024^2) / 2)
cohens_d_2024 <- (test_2024$additional[["Mean.x"]] - test_2024$additional[["Mean.y"]]) / pooled_sd_2024

# Statistical tests for 2020
pre_data_2020 <- pre_post_data_2020 %>% filter(period == "Pre-Election")
post_data_2020 <- pre_post_data_2020 %>% filter(period == "Post-Election")

test_2020 <- weights::wtd.t.test(
  x = post_data_2020$untrustworthy_flag_daily,
  y = pre_data_2020$untrustworthy_flag_daily,
  weight = post_data_2020$weight,
  weighty = pre_data_2020$weight
)

# Calculate Cohen's d for 2020 (Method 1: Hmisc::wtd.var pooled SD)
sd_post_2020 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = post_data_2020$untrustworthy_flag_daily, weights = post_data_2020$weight))
sd_pre_2020 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = pre_data_2020$untrustworthy_flag_daily, weights = pre_data_2020$weight))
pooled_sd_2020 <- sqrt((sd_post_2020^2 + sd_pre_2020^2) / 2)
cohens_d_2020 <- (test_2020$additional[["Mean.x"]] - test_2020$additional[["Mean.y"]]) / pooled_sd_2020

print("=== 2024 Pre-Election vs. Post-Election Test ===")
print(paste("Pre-Election: ", round(overall_pre_post_2024$percentage[1], 2), "% (95% CI [",
            round(overall_pre_post_2024$ci_lower[1], 2), "%, ",
            round(overall_pre_post_2024$ci_upper[1], 2), "%])"))
print(paste("Post-Election: ", round(overall_pre_post_2024$percentage[2], 2), "% (95% CI [",
            round(overall_pre_post_2024$ci_lower[2], 2), "%, ",
            round(overall_pre_post_2024$ci_upper[2], 2), "%])"))
print(paste("t-test: t(", round(test_2024$coefficients[2], 1), ") =", round(test_2024$coefficients[1], 3),
            ", p =", format.pval(test_2024$coefficients[3], digits = 3),
            ", Cohen's d =", round(cohens_d_2024, 3)))

print("=== 2020 Pre-Election vs. Post-Election Test ===")
print(paste("Pre-Election: ", round(overall_pre_post_2020$percentage[1], 2), "% (95% CI [",
            round(overall_pre_post_2020$ci_lower[1], 2), "%, ",
            round(overall_pre_post_2020$ci_upper[1], 2), "%])"))
print(paste("Post-Election: ", round(overall_pre_post_2020$percentage[2], 2), "% (95% CI [",
            round(overall_pre_post_2020$ci_lower[2], 2), "%, ",
            round(overall_pre_post_2020$ci_upper[2], 2), "%])"))
print(paste("t-test: t(", round(test_2020$coefficients[2], 1), ") =", round(test_2020$coefficients[1], 3),
            ", p =", format.pval(test_2020$coefficients[3], digits = 3),
            ", Cohen's d =", round(cohens_d_2020, 3)))
```

```{r partisan_pre_post_analysis}
# 2024 Partisan analysis

  main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = untrustworthy_flag_pre, w = weight),
      se = diagis::weighted_se(x = untrustworthy_flag_pre, w = weight),
      party_group = "Democrat",
      period = "Pre-Election",
      year = "2024"
    ),
  # Democrats Post
  main_2024 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = untrustworthy_flag_post, w = weight),
      se = diagis::weighted_se(x = untrustworthy_flag_post, w = weight),
      party_group = "Democrat",
      period = "Post-Election",
      year = "2024"
    ),
  # Republicans Pre
  main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = untrustworthy_flag_pre, w = weight),
      se = diagis::weighted_se(x = untrustworthy_flag_pre, w = weight),
      party_group = "Republican",
      period = "Pre-Election",
      year = "2024"
    ),
  # Republicans Post
  main_2024 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = untrustworthy_flag_post, w = weight),
      se = diagis::weighted_se(x = untrustworthy_flag_post, w = weight),
      party_group = "Republican",

    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = mean * 100,
    ci_lower = (mean - 1.96 * se) * 100,

  )

# 2020 Partisan analysis
partisan_2020 <- bind_rows(
  # Democrats Pre
  main_2020 %>% filter(democrat == 1) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = diagis::weighted_mean(x = untrustworthy_flag_pre, w = weight),

  # Republicans Pre

  main_2020 %>% filter(republican == 1) %>%
    summarise(

partisan_results <- bind_rows(partisan_2020, partisan_2024)

print("Partisan Pre-Election vs. Post-Election Exposure:")
print(knitr::kable(partisan_results %>%
                   select(year, party_group, period, percentage, ci_lower, ci_upper),
                   digits = 2))

# Statistical tests by party for 2024
parties <- c("Democrat", "Republican")
for (party in parties) {
  print(paste("=== 2024", party, "Pre vs Post ==="))

  party_data_2024 <- main_2024 %>% filter(!!sym(tolower(party)) == 1)

  party_test_2024 <- weights::wtd.t.test(
    x = party_data_2024$untrustworthy_flag_post,
    y = party_data_2024$untrustworthy_flag_pre,
    weight = party_data_2024$weight,
    weighty = party_data_2024$weight
  )

  # Calculate Cohen's d (Method 1: Hmisc::wtd.var pooled SD)
  sd_post_party_2024 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = party_data_2024$untrustworthy_flag_post, weights = party_data_2024$weight))
  sd_pre_party_2024 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = party_data_2024$untrustworthy_flag_pre, weights = party_data_2024$weight))
  pooled_sd_party_2024 <- sqrt((sd_post_party_2024^2 + sd_pre_party_2024^2) / 2)
  cohens_d_party_2024 <- (party_test_2024$additional[["Mean.x"]] - party_test_2024$additional[["Mean.y"]]) / pooled_sd_party_2024

  party_results_2024 <- partisan_2024 %>% filter(party_group == party)
  print(paste("Pre-Election: ", round(party_results_2024$percentage[1], 2), "% (95% CI [",
              round(party_results_2024$ci_lower[1], 2), "%, ",
              round(party_results_2024$ci_upper[1], 2), "%])"))
  print(paste("Post-Election: ", round(party_results_2024$percentage[2], 2), "% (95% CI [",
              round(party_results_2024$ci_lower[2], 2), "%, ",
              round(party_results_2024$ci_upper[2], 2), "%])"))
  print(paste("t-test: t(", round(party_test_2024$coefficients[2], 1), ") =", round(party_test_2024$coefficients[1], 3),
              ", p =", format.pval(party_test_2024$coefficients[3], digits = 3),
              ", Cohen's d =", round(cohens_d_party_2024, 3)))

  # 2020 tests
  print(paste("=== 2020", party, "Pre vs Post ==="))

  party_data_2020 <- main_2020 %>% filter(!!sym(tolower(party)) == 1)

  party_test_2020 <- weights::wtd.t.test(
    x = party_data_2020$untrustworthy_flag_post,
    y = party_data_2020$untrustworthy_flag_pre,
    weight = party_data_2020$weight,
    weighty = party_data_2020$weight
  )

  # Calculate Cohen's d (Method 1: Hmisc::wtd.var pooled SD)
  sd_post_party_2020 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = party_data_2020$untrustworthy_flag_post, weights = party_data_2020$weight))
  sd_pre_party_2020 <- sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = party_data_2020$untrustworthy_flag_pre, weights = party_data_2020$weight))
  pooled_sd_party_2020 <- sqrt((sd_post_party_2020^2 + sd_pre_party_2020^2) / 2)
  cohens_d_party_2020 <- (party_test_2020$additional[["Mean.x"]] - party_test_2020$additional[["Mean.y"]]) / pooled_sd_party_2020

  party_results_2020 <- partisan_2020 %>% filter(party_group == party)
  print(paste("Pre-Election: ", round(party_results_2020$percentage[1], 2), "% (95% CI [",
              round(party_results_2020$ci_lower[1], 2), "%, ",
              round(party_results_2020$ci_upper[1], 2), "%])"))
  print(paste("Post-Election: ", round(party_results_2020$percentage[2], 2), "% (95% CI [",
              round(party_results_2020$ci_lower[2], 2), "%, ",
              round(party_results_2020$ci_upper[2], 2), "%])"))
  print(paste("t-test: t(", round(party_test_2020$coefficients[2], 1), ") =", round(party_test_2020$coefficients[1], 3),
              ", p =", format.pval(party_test_2020$coefficients[3], digits = 3),
              ", Cohen's d =", round(cohens_d_party_2020, 3)))
  print("")
}
```

```{r interaction_analysis}
# Party × Period Interaction Analysis using person-level flags
print("=== Party × Period Interaction Analysis ===")

# Create long-format data for interaction analysis (2024)
interaction_data_2024 <- main_2024 %>%
  filter(democrat == 1 | republican == 1) %>%
  select(caseid, weight, democrat, republican, untrustworthy_flag_pre, untrustworthy_flag_post) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(untrustworthy_flag_pre, untrustworthy_flag_post),
    names_to = "period_raw",
    values_to = "exposed"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      period_raw == "untrustworthy_flag_pre" ~ "Pre-Election",
      period_raw == "untrustworthy_flag_post" ~ "Post-Election"
    ),
    party_group = case_when(
      democrat == 1 ~ "Democrat",
      republican == 1 ~ "Republican"
    ),
    republican_num = as.integer(republican == 1),
    post_election = as.integer(period == "Post-Election"),
    year = "2024"
  )

# Create long-format data for interaction analysis (2020)
interaction_data_2020 <- main_2020 %>%
  filter(democrat == 1 | republican == 1) %>%
  select(caseid, weight, democrat, republican, untrustworthy_flag_pre, untrustworthy_flag_post) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(untrustworthy_flag_pre, untrustworthy_flag_post),
    names_to = "period_raw",
    values_to = "exposed"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      period_raw == "untrustworthy_flag_pre" ~ "Pre-Election",
      period_raw == "untrustworthy_flag_post" ~ "Post-Election"
    ),
    party_group = case_when(
      democrat == 1 ~ "Democrat",
      republican == 1 ~ "Republican"
    ),
    republican_num = as.integer(republican == 1),
    post_election = as.integer(period == "Post-Election"),
    year = "2020"
  )

# Combine both years
interaction_data_combined <- bind_rows(interaction_data_2020, interaction_data_2024)

# Fit weighted regression with interaction for 2024
interaction_model_2024 <- lm(
  exposed ~ republican_num * post_election,
  data = interaction_data_2024,
  weights = weight
)

# Fit weighted regression with interaction for 2020
interaction_model_2020 <- lm(
  exposed ~ republican_num * post_election,
  data = interaction_data_2020,
  weights = weight
)

print("=== 2024 Party × Period Interaction Model ===")
model_summary_2024 <- summary(interaction_model_2024)
print(model_summary_2024)

print("=== 2020 Party × Period Interaction Model ===")
model_summary_2020 <- summary(interaction_model_2020)
print(model_summary_2020)

# Create comprehensive results table
interaction_results <- bind_rows(
  # 2024 results
  tibble(
    year = "2024",
    coefficient = c("Intercept (Dem Pre)", "Republican Effect", "Post-Election Effect", "Interaction (Rep × Post)"),
    estimate = model_summary_2024$coefficients[,1],
    std_error = model_summary_2024$coefficients[,2],
    t_value = model_summary_2024$coefficients[,3],
    p_value = model_summary_2024$coefficients[,4]
  ),
  # 2020 results
  tibble(
    year = "2020",
    coefficient = c("Intercept (Dem Pre)", "Republican Effect", "Post-Election Effect", "Interaction (Rep × Post)"),
    estimate = model_summary_2020$coefficients[,1],
    std_error = model_summary_2020$coefficients[,2],
    t_value = model_summary_2020$coefficients[,3],
    p_value = model_summary_2020$coefficients[,4]
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = estimate * 100,
    ci_lower = (estimate - 1.96 * std_error) * 100,
    ci_upper = (estimate + 1.96 * std_error) * 100,
    significance = case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      p_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

print("=== Comprehensive Interaction Analysis Results ===")
print(knitr::kable(
  interaction_results %>%
    select(year, coefficient, percentage, ci_lower, ci_upper, t_value, p_value, significance),
  digits = 3,
  col.names = c("Year", "Coefficient", "% Effect", "95% CI Lower", "95% CI Upper", "t-value", "p-value", "Sig.")
))

# Calculate predicted values for interpretation
predictions_2024 <- expand.grid(
  republican_num = c(0, 1),
  post_election = c(0, 1)
) %>%
  mutate(
    predicted = predict(interaction_model_2024, newdata = ., se.fit = TRUE),
    party = ifelse(republican_num == 1, "Republican", "Democrat"),
    period = ifelse(post_election == 1, "Post-Election", "Pre-Election"),
    percentage = predicted$fit * 100,
    se = predicted$se.fit * 100,
    ci_lower = percentage - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = percentage + 1.96 * se,
    year = "2024"
  )

predictions_2020 <- expand.grid(
  republican_num = c(0, 1),
  post_election = c(0, 1)
) %>%
  mutate(
    predicted = predict(interaction_model_2020, newdata = ., se.fit = TRUE),
    party = ifelse(republican_num == 1, "Republican", "Democrat"),
    period = ifelse(post_election == 1, "Post-Election", "Pre-Election"),
    percentage = predicted$fit * 100,
    se = predicted$se.fit * 100,
    ci_lower = percentage - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = percentage + 1.96 * se,
    year = "2020"
  )

predictions_combined <- bind_rows(predictions_2020, predictions_2024) %>%
  mutate(
    period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre-Election", "Post-Election")),
    year_label = paste0(year, " Election")
  )

print("=== Predicted Exposure Rates from Interaction Models ===")
print(knitr::kable(
  predictions_combined %>% select(year, party, period, percentage, ci_lower, ci_upper),
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c("Year", "Party", "Period", "Predicted %", "95% CI Lower", "95% CI Upper")
))

# Create interaction plot
interaction_plot <- predictions_combined %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = period, y = percentage, color = party, group = party)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~year_label) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Democrat" = "#4DBBD5FF", "Republican" = "#E64B35FF")) +
  labs(
    x = "Election Period",
    y = "Predicted Exposure Rate (%)",
    color = "Party",
    title = "Party × Period Interaction: Predicted Untrustworthy Website Exposure",
    subtitle = "Results from weighted regression models with 95% confidence intervals"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

interaction_plot

# Save the plot
ggsave("../figures/party-period-interaction.pdf", width = 7, height = 4)

# Statistical significance tests for interactions
print("=== Interaction Effect Significance Tests ===")
print(paste("2024 Interaction p-value:", format.pval(model_summary_2024$coefficients[4,4], digits = 3)))
print(paste("2020 Interaction p-value:", format.pval(model_summary_2020$coefficients[4,4], digits = 3)))

# Model fit statistics
print("=== Model Fit Statistics ===")
print(paste("2024 R-squared:", round(model_summary_2024$r.squared, 4)))
print(paste("2024 Adjusted R-squared:", round(model_summary_2024$adj.r.squared, 4)))
print(paste("2020 R-squared:", round(model_summary_2020$r.squared, 4)))
print(paste("2020 Adjusted R-squared:", round(model_summary_2020$adj.r.squared, 4)))
```
